newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka lifts ban on airconditioners.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka lifts ban on airconditioners.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state power utility, the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB), on Tuesday lifted a ban on the use of airconditioners running on grid power.
The move was possible because of increased thermal power generation and higher inflows into hydropower reservoirs, it said in a statement.

The CEB banned the use of airconditioners earlier this month and urged private sector businesses to use their own generators after water levels in hydro reservoirs plunged to dangerously low levels with the failure of rains.

Hydro resrvoirs supply 85 percent of the grid power. Sri Lanka now has an installed capacity of 1,135 megawatts of hydro-electric power and 250 megawatts of thermal power, moslty from diesel generation.
